[02:08.36]On a dark desert highway
[02:11.69]Cool wind in my hair
[02:14.75]Warm smell of colitas
[02:17.91]Rising up through the air
[02:21.27]Up ahead in the distance
[02:24.13]I saw a shimmering light
[02:27.37]My head grew heavy, and my sight grew dim
[02:30.67]I had to stop for the night
[02:34.11]There she stood in the doorway
[02:37.21]I heard the mission bell
[02:40.33]And I was thinking to myself
[02:42.72]This could be Heaven or this could be Hell
[02:46.80]Then she lit up a candle
[02:50.02]And she showed me the way
[02:53.16]There were voices down the corridor
[02:56.27]I thought I heard them say
[02:59.48]Welcome to the Hotel California
[03:05.09]Such a lovely place
[03:06.66]Such a lovely place
[03:08.42]Such a lovely face
[03:12.15]Plenty of rooms at the Hotel California
[03:17.86]Any time of year
[03:19.62]Any time of year
[03:21.23]You can find it here
[03:24.47]Her mind is Tiffany twisted
[03:28.14]She got the Mercedes Benz
[03:31.32]She got a lot of pretty, pretty boys
[03:34.43]That she calls friends
[03:37.87]How they dance in the courtyard
[03:40.56]Sweet summer sweat
[03:43.97]Some dance to remember
[03:47.25]Some dance to forget
[03:50.47]So I called up the Captain
[03:53.58]Please bring me my wine
[03:55.53]He said
[03:56.83]We havent had that spirit here since 1969
[04:03.71]And still those voices are calling from far away
[04:09.56]Wake you up in the middle of the night
[04:12.81]Just to hear them say
[04:15.94]Welcome to the Hotel California
[04:21.52]Such a lovely Place
[04:23.57]Such a lovely Place
[04:25.50]Such a lovely face
[04:28.44]They're livin it up at the Hotel California
[04:34.26]What a nice surprise
[04:36.09]What a nice surprise
[04:37.65]Bring your alibis
[04:41.67]Mirrors on the ceiling
[04:44.81]Pink champagne on ice
[04:47.07]And she said
[04:48.04]We are all just prisoners here
[04:51.46]Of our own device
[04:54.82]And in the masters chambers
[04:58.06]They gathered for the feast
[05:01.19]They stab it with their steely knives
[05:04.30]But they just can't kill the beast
[05:07.54]Last thing I remember
[05:10.67]I was running for the door
[05:14.04]I had to find the passage back to the place I was before
[05:20.45]Relax said the nightman
[05:23.00]We are programed to receive
[05:26.91]You can check out any time you like
[05:30.29]But you can never leave

tlyric.lyric:
[by:stonerao]
[02:08.36]行驶在漆黑荒芜的公路上
[02:11.69]凉风吹过我的头发
[02:14.75]温热的气息
[02:17.91]在空中袅袅上升
[02:21.27]在前方远处
[02:24.13]我看见隐约闪烁的灯光
[02:27.37]我头晕眼花
[02:30.67]必须找地方过夜
[02:34.11]她就站在门口欢迎我
[02:37.21]听见教堂的钟声
[02:40.33]我寻思道
[02:42.72]这里可能是天堂，也可能是地狱
[02:46.80]她点亮了蜡烛
[02:50.02]为我引路
[02:53.16]穿过走廊传来阵阵说话声
[02:56.27]我仿佛听到他们在说
[02:59.48]欢迎来到加州旅馆！
[03:05.09]如此美丽的地方！
[03:06.66]多么可爱的地方！
[03:08.42]多么可爱的面容！
[03:12.15]加州旅馆有充足的房间
[03:17.86]一年四季任何时候
[03:19.62]一年四季任何时候
[03:21.23]你都能随时入住
[03:24.47]她纸醉金迷
[03:28.14]她拥有豪华奔驰车
[03:31.32]她有许多称之为朋友的
[03:34.43]帅气小伙子
[03:37.87]他们在院子里狂舞
[03:40.56]夏日里尽情挥汗如雨
[03:43.97]有些人狂舞是为了回忆
[03:47.25]有些人狂舞是为了遗忘
[03:50.47]我叫来了领班
[03:53.58]请给我来点酒
[03:55.53]他说
[03:56.83]自从1969年之后我们就没有这种东西了
[04:03.71]远处仍然传来他们的话语
[04:09.56]半夜把你惊醒
[04:12.81]只听到他们在说
[04:15.94]欢迎来到加州旅馆！
[04:21.52]如此美丽的地方
[04:23.57]如此美丽的地方
[04:25.50]多么可爱的面容！
[04:28.44]他们在加州旅馆尽情狂欢
[04:34.26]多么美妙的惊喜
[04:36.09]多么美妙的惊喜
[04:37.65]让你欲罢不能
[04:41.67]天花板上的镜子
[04:44.81]冰镇的粉红香槟
[04:47.07]她说
[04:48.04]我们都是这里
[04:51.46]自投罗网的囚徒
[04:54.82]在主人的房间里
[04:58.06]他们聚集一堂享受盛宴
[05:01.19]他们挥舞着钢制小刀
[05:04.30]但却不能杀死这头野兽
[05:07.54]我记得的最后一件事
[05:10.67]是我跑向门口
[05:14.04]我必须找到来时的路，回到之前的地方
[05:20.45]守夜人说，放松点
[05:23.00]我们只是照常接待
[05:26.91]你想什么时候结帐都可以
[05:30.29]但你永远无法离开！
